links.to_node: I do not convert my traditional auto repair shop into an electric vehicle service center.
My auto repair shop continues operating as a traditional gasoline vehicle service center.
My current employees retain their jobs temporarily.
I face eventual mandatory closure or conversion due to the new law.
My shop may experience declining business as gasoline vehicles are phased out.

Customers with electric vehicles may not be served by my shop.
